title: Caldillo de congrio (Chilean conger eel soup)

ingredients.name: conger eel or firm white fish fillets (hake, cod or pollock), cut into large pieces

steps: Season the fish with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Heat the oil in a large pot and cook the onion, carrot and garlic over medium heat until the onion is soft, about 7 minutes. Stir in the cumin and oregano.
Add the potatoes and the stock, bring to a boil and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes until the potatoes are nearly tender.
Lower the fish into the broth, spacing the pieces out, and simmer gently for 6 to 8 minutes until it flakes. Do not stir hard, so the pieces stay whole.
Pour in the cream, warm it through for a minute and taste for salt.
Ladle into deep bowls, scatter with cilantro and serve with lemon wedges and crusty bread.

title: Chacarero (Chilean steak sandwich with green beans)

ingredients.name: round bread rolls, split (hallulla or soft rolls)
beef sirloin or rump steak, very thinly sliced
green chili (ají verde) or pickled green chilies, sliced

steps: Boil the green beans in salted water for 6 to 8 minutes until tender, drain and slice them lengthwise into thin strips.
Season the steak slices with salt and sear them quickly in the hot oil for 1 to 2 minutes per side, in batches so they brown rather than steam.
Warm the rolls and spread the insides with mayonnaise.
Layer the meat, tomato slices and green beans in each roll.
Top with slices of green chili for heat, as much as you like, and close the sandwich.
Serve warm, wrapped in paper for eating by hand.

title: Chapalele (Chiloé potato and flour dumplings)

ingredients.name: wheat flour, plus extra for dusting
pebre or a meat stew, to serve

steps: Mash the hot potatoes until completely smooth, with no lumps.
Mix in the salt and gradually work in the flour, using only as much as you need to form a soft dough that is no longer sticky.
Dust the work surface with flour, divide the dough into 8 portions and flatten each into a disc about 1.5 cm thick.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Lower in the chapaleles a few at a time and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes; they will float when cooked.
Lift them out with a slotted spoon and drain.
Brush with melted lard or butter and serve hot with pebre, or alongside a meat or seafood stew.

title: Charquicán (Chilean beef, potato and pumpkin stew)

ingredients.name: beef stew meat, cut in small cubes
pumpkin or butternut squash, peeled and cubed

steps: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large pot and brown the beef well on all sides, then remove it.
In the same pot, cook the onion and garlic with the cumin, oregano and merkén until soft, 5 minutes.
Return the beef, add the carrot and enough water to just cover, then simmer covered for 45 minutes until the meat is nearly tender.
Add the potatoes, pumpkin, corn and peas with a little more water if needed. Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring now and then.
Mash part of the vegetables against the pot with a wooden spoon so the stew becomes thick and creamy. Season with salt and pepper.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil and serve one on top of each portion.

title: Chorrillana (Chilean piled fries with beef, onions and eggs)

ingredients.name: beef steak (sirloin or flank), thinly sliced
vegetable oil, plus more for frying the potatoes

steps: Fry the potatoes in hot oil until cooked and golden, drain on paper towels and season with salt. Keep warm in a low oven.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a wide skillet over high heat and fry the onions with a pinch of salt for about 8 minutes until soft and lightly browned. Remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, sear the beef slices for 2 to 3 minutes with oregano, salt and pepper until browned.
Return the onions to the pan and toss together for 1 minute.
Fry the eggs in a little oil, sunny side up.
Pile the fries on a large platter, top with the meat and onions, crown with the fried eggs and serve at once for everyone to share.

title: Completo (Chilean loaded hot dog)
steps: Mash the avocados with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt, keeping some texture.
Dice the tomatoes finely, drain off excess juice and season lightly with salt.
Heat the frankfurters in simmering water for 5 to 7 minutes, or grill them until hot and lightly browned.
Warm the buns lightly in a dry pan or oven.
Place a frankfurter in each bun and layer on the diced tomato, then the mashed avocado, then the sauerkraut.
Finish with a generous squiggle of mayonnaise and serve immediately with napkins.

title: Curanto en olla (Chiloé pot-steamed meats, shellfish and potatoes)

ingredients.name: pork ribs or shoulder, cut into pieces

steps: Rinse the shellfish well and discard any that stay open when tapped.
Line the bottom of a very large pot with half of the cabbage leaves and pour in the wine.
Layer the pork, chicken and sausages, season lightly with salt and pepper and add the potatoes.
Cover with the remaining leaves and a tight lid. Cook over medium heat for 25 minutes, so the meats start to cook in the steam.

Scatter the mussels and clams over the top, replace the leaves and lid and steam for another 15 to 20 minutes, until the shells have opened and the pork and chicken are cooked through. Discard unopened shells.
Serve in bowls with the juices from the pot, as is traditional with the broth on the side.

title: Ensalada chilena (Chilean tomato and onion salad)

ingredients.name: ripe tomatoes, sliced or cut in wedges
large white onion, very thinly sliced
lemon juice or red wine vinegar

steps: Put the sliced onion in a bowl, cover with boiling water mixed with a teaspoon of salt and leave for 5 minutes to soften its bite. Drain and rinse well in cold water.
Arrange the tomatoes on a platter or in a bowl.
Scatter the drained onion over the tomatoes, with the cilantro and the chili if using.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice and a good pinch of salt together and pour over the salad.
Let the salad rest for 10 minutes so the flavors blend, then serve with grilled meat or bread.

title: Lomo a lo pobre (Chilean beef steak with fries, onions and fried eggs)

ingredients.name: vegetable oil, plus more for frying the potatoes
salt and black pepper to taste

steps: Fry the potato fries in hot oil until golden and crisp, drain and salt them. Keep warm.
Cook the onions in 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat with a pinch of salt for 12 to 15 minutes until deeply golden. Set aside.
Season the steaks well with salt and pepper and sear in a very hot skillet for 3 to 4 minutes per side for medium. Rest them on a plate.
Fry the eggs in the same pan with the remaining oil until the whites are set and the yolks remain soft.
Pile fries on four plates, set a steak on top of each, then add the onions and finish with a fried egg.
Serve immediately.

title: Machas a la parmesana (Chilean razor clams grilled with Parmesan)

ingredients.name: razor clams or other clams in the shell, scrubbed

steps: Heat the oven grill to high.
Put the clams and wine in a wide pot, cover and steam over medium-high heat for 4 to 6 minutes until the shells open. Discard any that stay closed.
Remove the clams from their shells, pat the meat dry and chop roughly if the clams are large. Keep the best half of each shell.
Set the half shells on a baking tray and put the clam meat back in them.
Mix the melted butter with the garlic and spoon a little over each shell, then cover generously with Parmesan and a grind of pepper.
Grill for 3 to 5 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and golden. Serve at once with lemon wedges.

title: Marraqueta (Chilean crusty split bread rolls)
steps: Mix the flour, salt and yeast. Add the water and oil and knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover and let the dough rise for 1 1/2 hours until doubled in size.
Divide into 4 equal pieces. Shape each piece into a short oval, then form two ovals side by side, pressing them together lengthwise with the side of your hand dipped in flour.
Place on a floured tray, cover and let rise for 40 minutes.
Heat the oven to 230 C and place a tray of water on the bottom shelf.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until the crust is deep golden and crisp. Cool on a rack; each marraqueta pulls apart in two halves.

title: Milcao (Chiloé potato cakes)

ingredients.name: raw potatoes, peeled and finely grated
lard or vegetable oil, for frying

steps: Wrap the grated raw potato in a clean cloth and squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
Mix the squeezed potato with the mashed potato, flour and salt to form a firm dough. If it is too wet, add a spoonful more flour.
Divide into 8 portions. Flatten each into a thick disc and, if you like, press a little chicharrón into the center and fold the dough around it.
Heat the lard in a large skillet over medium heat.
Fry the milcaos for 5 to 6 minutes per side until deep golden and cooked through.
Serve hot, as a side with stews or on their own with pebre.

title: Mote con huesillo (Chilean wheat and dried peach cooler)

ingredients.name: husked wheat (mote), or pearl barley or wheat berries

steps: Soak the dried peaches in 500 ml of water overnight, and soak the wheat in cold water overnight too.
Drain the wheat, cover with fresh water and simmer for 45 to 60 minutes until tender but still slightly chewy. Drain and rinse.
Put the peaches with their soaking water, the sugar, cinnamon, orange peel and the remaining water in a pan and simmer for 20 to 30 minutes until the peaches are plump and the liquid is syrupy.
Cool the syrup completely and remove the cinnamon and peel.
Divide the wheat among tall glasses, add 2 peaches to each and pour the syrup over.
Chill and serve very cold, with ice, and eat with a spoon.

title: Niños envueltos (Chilean cabbage rolls with spiced beef)
steps: Blanch the cabbage leaves in boiling water for 3 to 4 minutes until pliable, drain and trim the thick stems.
Heat the oil and cook the onion and garlic until soft, add the beef and brown, breaking it up. Stir in the cumin, oregano, salt and pepper.
Mix the cooked beef with the rice and let the filling cool slightly.
Place a few tablespoons of filling on each cabbage leaf, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Arrange the rolls seam side down in a wide pot, pour over the tomato sauce and stock.
Cover and simmer gently for 35 to 40 minutes until the cabbage is tender. Serve with the sauce spooned over.

title: Paila marina (Chilean seafood stew)

ingredients.name: firm white fish fillets, in chunks

steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and cook the onion and garlic for 5 minutes until soft, then add the tomatoes and merkén and cook for another 5 minutes.
Pour in the wine and let it reduce by half, then add the fish stock and bring to a boil.
Add the clams and mussels, cover and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until they begin to open.
Add the fish chunks and shrimp and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes until the fish is opaque and the shrimp are pink. Discard any shells that did not open.
Taste for salt and stir in the cilantro.
Serve in deep bowls with lemon wedges and bread for the broth.

title: Pan de Pascua (Chilean Christmas fruit and honey cake)
steps: Soak the candied fruit and raisins in the pisco or rum for 30 minutes. Heat the oven to 170 C and line a loaf pan or round cake tin.
Beat the butter, sugar and honey together until pale and fluffy, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
Sift the flour with the baking powder, ginger, cinnamon and cloves.
Fold the dry ingredients into the batter alternately with the milk until just combined.
Stir in the soaked fruit with any remaining liquid, plus the walnuts.
Pour into the pan and bake for 50 to 60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool in the tin for 15 minutes, then turn out and store wrapped for a day before slicing.

title: Pantrucas (Chilean dumpling soup)
steps: Make the dough: mix the flour, water, oil and 1/2 teaspoon of salt until smooth, knead for a few minutes, cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Place the beef, onion, garlic, cumin and stock in a pot with 1 teaspoon of salt. Bring to a boil and simmer, covered, for 1 hour until the meat is tender.
Add the carrot and potatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Roll the dough out thinly on a floured surface and tear or cut it into irregular pieces about 3 to 4 cm wide.
Drop the dough pieces into the simmering soup one at a time and cook for 5 to 7 minutes until they float and are tender.
Season, stir in the parsley and serve piping hot.

title: Pebre (Chilean fresh herb and tomato salsa)

ingredients.name: fresh green chili, finely chopped, or to taste

steps: Place the chopped onion in a bowl and rinse it in cold water for a minute to soften its bite, then drain well.
Combine the onion, tomatoes, cilantro, garlic and chili in a bowl.
Add the oil, vinegar and 1 teaspoon of salt and stir well.
Let the pebre rest for at least 20 minutes so the flavors blend, then taste for salt, vinegar and heat.
Serve with bread, grilled meats, empanadas or potatoes.

title: Porotos con riendas (Chilean beans with spaghetti and pumpkin)

ingredients.name: dried beans (cranberry or borlotti), soaked overnight

steps: Drain the soaked beans, cover with fresh water in a large pot and simmer for 45 to 60 minutes until nearly tender.
In a skillet, fry the onion, garlic and chorizo in the oil for about 8 minutes, then stir in the cumin and paprika.
Tip the sofrito into the beans along with the pumpkin and 1 teaspoon of salt. Add hot water if the stew has become dry.
Simmer for 15 minutes until the pumpkin is soft; it will thicken the stew when lightly mashed.
Add the broken spaghetti, the reins, and cook for 8 to 10 minutes until tender, stirring often as the stew thickens.
Season and serve in warm bowls.

title: Tortilla de rescoldo (Chilean ember-baked flatbread)
steps: Mix the flour, salt and baking powder in a large bowl and rub in the lard until it looks like sand.
Gradually add the warm water and knead into a smooth, soft dough; add the chicharrón if using.
Rest the dough, covered, for 20 minutes.
Divide into 6 pieces and pat each into a flat disc about 1 cm thick.
Cook on embers if you have them, or in a dry cast-iron skillet over medium heat, or on a tray in a hot 220 C oven, for 6 to 8 minutes per side until golden brown with dark spots.
Brush off any ash, split while warm and serve with butter, pebre or cheese.
